claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_scope_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Deflect Energy is a permanent always-on modifier that widens the damage type filter on Deflect Attacks. It has no activation cost, no use count, no resource, and no trigger — the activation family cannot represent it without lying about all of those fields.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can now use your Deflect Attacks feature against attacks that deal any damage type, not just Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: expand_damage_type_scope (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive family existed, no current ClassFeatureEffect variant can express 'remove the damage type restriction on feature X'. A new effect variant is needed that names the target feature and declares the restriction being lifted.
